critical_code_review_comments: ml.py sam2_propose uses a single global _sam2_last_image_id — under concurrent requests for different images the cache would thrash. For a single-annotator pilot this is fine; if you ever move to multi-user, switch to an LRU keyed by image_id with the actual embedding cached (SAM2 recomputes set_image each time key mismatches).

server.py ml_propose catches all Exception in the SAM2 branch and returns backend=='sam2_error' with str(e) exposed to the client — acceptable for internal pilot, but consider logging server-side and returning a stable error_code so the frontend can branch on it without string matching.

ml.py generate_and_store hard-codes coordinate_space='exif_applied_display' as default; approve endpoint never overrides it. Add an explicit contract test that any raster_png submitted uses the same EXIF-applied display size (already asserted implicitly by resize to (w,h)).
